description:
List traces from Langfuse with optional filters and pagination.

Returns a summary of each trace: id, name, timestamp, userId, latency, totalCost, tags, and observation/score counts. The input and output fields are omitted from the list view for brevity — use get_trace_detail to see the full trace including I/O.

Any field value exceeding 1000 characters is automatically truncated and saved to a /tmp file. The truncated text includes the file path — use grep on that file to search within large values.

**Pagination:** Use page and limit to paginate. Response includes meta.totalItems and meta.totalPages.

**Sorting:** Use orderBy (e.g. "timestamp.desc") to control result order.

fromTimestamp.description: Only include traces created on or after this ISO 8601 datetime. Example: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z".

limit.description: Number of traces per page (1-100). Default: 10. Use smaller values to reduce response size.

orderBy.description: Sort order as "field.direction". Fields: id, timestamp, name, userId, release, version, public, bookmarked, sessionId. Direction: asc, desc. Example: "timestamp.desc".

tags.description: Filter to traces containing ALL specified tags. Example: ["production", "important"].

toTimestamp.description: Only include traces created before this ISO 8601 datetime. Example: "2025-02-01T00:00:00Z".

userId.description: Filter by user ID associated with traces.

name: get_traces
